query:
The club operates with the understanding that everyone shares their Strava after every ride. Based on the conversations, does this apply to every member equally? If not, who treats this differently in practice, and what in their behaviour shows it?

Options:
A. Lena and Marcus
B. Tomás and Ben
C. Derek and Yuki
D. Saoirse and Priya
context:
[1] (about=Callum, episodic, t12 @2026-02-21T12:15:00) Priya mentioned half the group thought I did not like them. Wanted to address that directly. I am here for the riding but I am also just not great at group chat. Not personal.
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t12 @2026-02-21T12:08:00) ok Marcus admitting a 55km ride counts as a ride is genuinely historic, screenshot this everyone 📸
[3] (about=Ben, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:40:00) haha for the record I think the café is what makes the ride worth doing. not just the ride itself. the whole thing, travel there, suffer a bit, then sit somewhere warm and eat something good.
[4] (about=Callum, core, t18 @2026-03-14T13:32:00) Full season data pack will be in Strava group by Wednesday: 10 sessions, 9 members, 783.4km total group distance.
[5] (about=Callum, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Received GPX file; notes Strava segment for main climb is 4.7km at 6.2% average.
[6] (about=Derek, episodic, t16 @2026-03-07T13:35:00) For what it is worth, today's ride was well-paced across the board. The Saoirse-at-social-tempo experiment works. I will stay for coffee again today since it went well last week.
[7] (about=Lena, episodic, t10 @2026-02-14T12:16:00) From a physio perspective that is actually an ideal model. You get the social element and the movement without the load that would compound fatigue. I am happy to run that loop with you whenever the main route does not suit. It is genuinely good periodisation.
[8] (about=Marcus, said_by=Priya, profile, t12 @2026-02-21T11:51:00) Priya said Marcus admitting a 55km ride counts as a ride is genuinely historic.
[9] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Co-organizer of rides with Tomás.
[10] (about=Priya, core, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Wants weekly group rides; fortnightly is not enough.
[11] (about=Priya, core, t13 @2026-02-28T12:15:00) Wants to make group rides weekly; solo sessions are terrible and unmotivating.
[12] (about=Saoirse, core, t8 @2026-02-07T09:21:00) Will be at most rides from now on; racing league moved to Saturday evenings.
[13] (about=Tomás, core, t0 @2026-01-10T08:15:00) Co-organizer of rides with Marcus.
agent_answer:
No — it doesn’t apply equally. The two who treat it differently are **Lena and Marcus (A)**.

- **Marcus**: the group calls it “genuinely historic” that Marcus admitted a 55 km ride counts as a ride. That implies he usually doesn’t count shorter rides, so he wouldn’t share/log every ride on Strava.
- **Lena**: she says she’s happy to “run that loop” instead of the main route when it doesn’t suit, meaning she substitutes an alternate activity/loop rather than the standard ride — so she doesn’t always have the club ride to share.
